en_version: Metsudah Chumash, Metsudah Publications, 2009 [with Onkelos translation]
he: וּקְרָא יְיָ לִנְהוֹרָא יְמָמָא וְלַחֲשׁוֹכָא קְרָא לֵילְיָא וַהֲוָה רְמַשׁ וַהֲוָה צְפַר יוֹמָא חָד:
en: Elohim called the light day, and the darkness He called night. It became evening and it became morning, one day.
